name: Port ScriptSession and GameHost: loading the game, the hooks and the frame loop

comments.text: Part 2c: ScriptSession.nox, GameHost.nox, EngineHostSurface, and engine/src/runner/RunGame.nox, so build/lantern <game-directory> runs a game. Without the Chaos parts, which come with L7: the session starts no Chaos UI, and the host doesn't navigate, update or draw it. Tested with a small Chaos-free game in tests/support/games/drop (load, frames, F5 reload without leaks, F1, Quit, a failing hook, failed loads), and it ran on the GPU through build/lantern.
